check_box.name: unlock_pelvis_for_bvh_save_checkbox
check_box.label: Unlock Pelvis in BVH
check_box.tool_tip: When you save this pose to BVH, the Pelvis will not be 'locked'. This means other animations in-world can 'move' the whole avatar. Use this if your pose is meant to play 'on top of' another pose.

slider.name: trackpad_sensitivity_slider
slider.tool_tip: Adjusts the sensitivity of the trackball

check_box.name: stop_posing_on_close_checkbox
check_box.label: Stop posing when closed
check_box.tool_tip: Not stopping your pose can be helpful if you do a lot of work, and don't want to accidentally lose it.

check_box.name: also_save_bvh_checkbox
check_box.label: Write BVH when saving
check_box.tool_tip: When you save your pose, also write a BVH file. BVH can be uploaded via the 'Build > Upload > Animation' to pose yourself or others in-world. This needs joints to reset their 'base' to zero, because BVH requires original work.

check_box.name: confirm_overwrite_on_save_checkbox
check_box.label: Confirm Overwrite
check_box.tool_tip: When you save a pose, if the file already exists, you need to click the save button again to confirm you are sure you want to overwrite.

check_box.name: natural_direction_checkbox
check_box.label: Use natural alignment
check_box.tool_tip: The skeleton has unnatural joint rotations by default. This complicates posing. When checked, the joints will rotate in a more natural way.

check_box.name: show_joint_markers_checkbox
check_box.label: Show joint markers
check_box.tool_tip: Show small indicators to aid joint selection when posing.

check_box.name: dof_edit_mode_checkbox
check_box.label: Enable DoF in Edit Mode
check_box.tool_tip: When using the Manipulator, Depth of Field normally disables automatically. This keeps Depth of Field on when editing poses or prims.

button.name: toggleVisualManipulators
button.tool_tip: Toggle the visual manipulators on and off

fs_virtual_trackpad.name: limb_rotation
fs_virtual_trackpad.tool_tip: Change the rotation of the currently selected body part(s). Hold Ctrl to move slow. Roll the wheel to adjust the 3rd axis. Use Shift or Alt to swap which rotations change

button.name: undo_change

button.name: button_redo_change
button.tool_tip: Re-do the last change

button.name: poser_joint_reset
button.tool_tip: Click to reset the selected body part(s) to when you first started posing

button.name: delta_mode_toggle
button.tool_tip: If changing multiple joints, each changes by the same amount instead of getting the same change. Also used for breaking Gimbal Lock.

button.name: toggle_LockWorldRotation
button.tool_tip: Lock rotation in the world for the selected limb(s). Limbs that are world-locked keep the same rotation in-world when their parent-limbs move. Eg: lock your eyes and turn your head, your eyes keep looking (mostly) in the same direction.

panel.name: poser_inventory_panel

button.name: poser_inventory_load
button.label: Load Inventory Animation
button.tool_tip: Select an animation in inventory and click here, or drag it directly into Poser.

button.name: poser_inventory_clear
button.label: Clear
button.tool_tip: Discard local edits and begin a new pose.

button.name: poser_inventory_export
button.label: Export ANIM
button.tool_tip: Save an edited native animation with original keyframes, timing, priorities and constraints. Only the inventory creator can export.

slider.name: poser_inventory_timeline
slider.tool_tip: Scrub through the loaded animation. Click Set Key to commit joint changes before moving to another time.

button.name: poser_inventory_setkey
button.label: Set Key
button.tool_tip: Commit the selected, enabled joints at the current timeline time.

button.name: poser_inventory_offset
button.label: Adjust Clip
button.tool_tip: Apply the selected joint adjustments to their entire animation curves.

button.name: poser_inventory_extend
button.label: Extend +1s
button.tool_tip: Add one second holding the last pose, then use Set Key to edit the new end.

panel.text: Drag an inventory animation here, or select one and click Load.
